<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import { RadioGroupRoot, type RadioGroupRootEmits, type RadioGroupRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<RadioGroupRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<RadioGroupRootEmits>();

const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroupRoot
    class="sigma-ui-radio-group"
    data-slot="radio-group"
    v-bind="{ ...forwarded, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <slot />
  </RadioGroupRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-radio-group {
  display: grid;
  gap: 0.5rem;
}
</style>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { useAttrs } from 'vue';

import {
  RadioGroupIndicator,
  RadioGroupItem,
  type RadioGroupItemProps,
  useForwardProps,
} from 'reka-ui';
import { CircleIcon } from 'lucide-vue-next';
defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
});

const attrs = useAttrs();

const delegatedAttrs = () => {
  return Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(attrs).filter(([key]) => key !== 'class'));
};

const props = defineProps<RadioGroupItemProps>();

const forwardedProps = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroupItem
    data-slot="radio-group-item"
    v-bind="{ ...forwardedProps, ...delegatedAttrs() }"
    class="sigma-ui-radio-group-item"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <RadioGroupIndicator
      class="sigma-ui-radio-group-item__indicator"
    >
      <CircleIcon class="sigma-ui-radio-group-item__icon" />
    </RadioGroupIndicator>
  </RadioGroupItem>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-radio-group-item {
  width: 1rem;
  height: 1rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--primary);
  border-radius: var(--radius-full);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--primary);
  transition: all 150ms ease-out;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item:focus {
  outline: none;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item:disabled {
  cursor: not-allowed;
  opacity: 0.5;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item__indicator {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item__icon {
  width: 0.625rem;
  height: 0.625rem;
  color: currentcolor;
  fill: currentcolor;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item[data-state="checked"] .sigma-ui-radio-group-item__icon {
  animation: sigma-ui-radio-check 150ms ease-out;
}

.sigma-ui-radio-group-item[data-state="unchecked"] .sigma-ui-radio-group-item__icon {
  animation: sigma-ui-radio-uncheck 150ms ease-in;
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-radio-check {
  from {
    filter: blur(4px);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.8);
  }

  to {
    filter: blur(0);
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }
}

@keyframes sigma-ui-radio-uncheck {
  from {
    filter: blur(0);
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1);
  }

  to {
    filter: blur(4px);
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(0.8);
  }
}
</style>

export { default as RadioGroup } from './RadioGroup.vue';
export { default as RadioGroupItem } from './RadioGroupItem.vue';
